title: lifr
text: Import, plot, report Laser-Induced Fluorescence (LIF) borehole logs high-resolution site characterization surveys (UVOST, TarGOST, similar direct-push fluorescence probes). Import raw .lif.dat.txt logs tidy data frame keeps every channel instrument recorded, boring coordinates joined locations file. Edit known-bad depth intervals recorded audit trail travels data prints report. Summarise plot: depth profiles, multi-channel overviews, plan-view boring maps (optionally USGS aerial imagery), depth-slice maps, site summary charts. Report: self-contained HTML site report Summary, Data & QA, Processing history, Boring logs tabs, plus Markdown PDF.

code: library(lifr)  demo <- system.file("extdata", "demo", package = "lifr") lif <- lif_import(demo)              # logs + locations, all channels kept lif  lif <- lif_zero_shallow(lif, depth = 1)                  # mask surface smear lif <- lif_editor(lif, "LIF-03", top = 20, bottom = 22)  # mask an artifact edit_history(lif)                                        # the audit trail  summarize_lif(lif)$by_boring lif_plot_all(lif, ncol = 4) boring_map(lif, use_instrument_color = TRUE)  site <- process_site(demo, output_dir = "out", site_name = "Demo Site") site$reports$html

what: lifr: import, plot, and report LIF borehole logs — lifr-package
title: lifr: import, plot, and report LIF borehole logs — lifr-package
text: Laser-Induced Fluorescence (LIF) probes UVOST TarGOST pushed ground record fluorescence response fixed depth interval. boring produces one log file. lifr reads logs tidy data frame, joins boring coordinates locations file, lets mask known-bad depth intervals recorded audit trail, summarises plots data, renders site report.

title: lifr: import, plot, and report LIF borehole logs — lifr-package
text: Every importer returns lif_data object: data frame one row per depth reading least columns boring, depth (ft ground surface, downward-positive), signal (LIF response, %RE). locations file joined frame also carries easting, northing, msl (ground-surface elevation, ft). Optional instrument channels canonicalised ec (electrical conductivity, mS/m), hp (hydraulic push pressure, psi), color (emission-wavelength hex colour). Every column source file kept cleaned snake_case name, nothing recorded instrument lost import.

title: lifr: import, plot, and report LIF borehole logs — lifr-package
text: LIF response relative fluorescence, expressed percentage reference emitter (%RE). indicates fluorescent product likely present. concentration comparable regulatory criteria; lifr never maps %RE onto criteria.

title: lifr: import, plot, and report LIF borehole logs — lifr-package
code: lif <- lif_import("data/LIF")                 # read logs + locations lif <- lif_zero_shallow(lif, depth = 2)       # mask surface noise lif <- lif_editor(lif, "B-07", top = 18.5, bottom = 19.2) edit_history(lif)                             # audit trail summarize_lif(lif) lif_plot_all(lif, layout = "facet") boring_map(lif) site <- process_site("data/LIF", output_dir = "out") site$reports$html

title: Run the import -> edit -> correct -> summarise -> report pipeline for a site — process_site
text: data_dir Directory .lif.dat.txt files (, usually, locations file). locations_file Passed lif_import(). edits Optional batch edit plan: CSV path data frame lif_apply_edits(). corrections Named list corrections applied edits, order: zero_shallow: depth (ft); readings zeroed via lif_zero_shallow(). zero_below: %RE threshold; readings zeroed via lif_zero_below_threshold(). hp: TRUE hp_correction() defaults, named list arguments list(water_table = 8). output_dir Directory charts report (created missing). prefix Filename prefix charts report. Default: slug site_name. site_name Human-readable site name. Default: data_dir basename. crs Projected CRS (EPSG code) coordinates. supplied report adds boring map USGS aerial imagery via fetch_basemap(); needs network access degrades note offline. charts Logical. Write site summary charts PNGs. report Logical. Render report. report_formats "html", "md", "pdf". response_thresholds Summary tab lists borings whose peak exceeds %RE values. NULL suppresses tables. date_suffix Logical. Append _YYMMDD prefix successive runs sit side side. quiet Suppress progress messages.

what: Render the site report from a lif_site object — site_report
title: Render the site report from a lif_site object — site_report
text: Renders object returned process_site() : "html": one self-contained file (inline CSS/JS, base64 figures, sortable tables) four tabs: Summary (tiles, boring maps, %RE proxy disclosure, peak-response tables), Data & QA (per-boring inventory, summary statistics, site charts), Processing history (complete edit log, corrections, pipeline steps), Boring logs (input-vs-edited log pairs changed-filter). Printing shows every tab section. "md": Markdown document references figures PNG sidecars written next . "pdf": Markdown rendered rmarkdown (pandoc plus LaTeX distribution providing xelatex, TinyTeX). Skipped warning toolchain missing. title: Summarise a LIF channel for QA reporting — summarize_lif
text: data lif_data frame. channel Column summarise. Default "signal"; "ec" "hp" also work. thresholds Threshold values $by_threshold. Default 0. sort_by Order $by_boring: "peak" (descending, default) "input" (first-appearance order). plot Logical. Also print lollipop chart peak signal per boring (see chart_peak_by_boring()).
